scope: 400 source-only PPO rollouts, changed TRAIN starts only; no original-start corner gain, no promotion.

handoff.objective: Run a bounded source-only on-policy PPO curriculum for complicated corner navigation while retaining rooms and vertical capability.
handoff.decision: Do not promote and do not extend this PPO curriculum. No stage gained an original-start corner DEV success. The best total DEV score matched the 54/90 control but missed room retention by one.

stages.train_reset_episodes: 1810/4824 success across all three sampled families

trace_evidence.finding: Both policies command forward motion near 1.4 m/s with near-zero yaw from the original start. They do not reach the first side opening and collide by 2.2-3.8 s. The stage-3 positive-y route spends over 3 s near the first partition while its lateral command changes sign.

handoff.next_action: Root reviews the source and receipts. Do not extend this PPO curriculum without new corner progress. Test pre-contact active sensing or longer-lived memory/map in a separate source experiment, with the preserved control and the same all-90 DEV retention gate.
